tieRule.text: When lowest, highest, or most is tied, the tied player nearest Initiative clockwise is the target unless the effect explicitly applies to everyone.

agiEmergence.meaning: At least one institution holds recognized AGI.

$conditions.singularity: AGI is recognized and average final Reputation is at least 3.
$conditions.closed_loop: AGI is recognized and average final Reputation is below 3.
$conditions.plural_future: AGI is not recognized and average final Reputation is at least 3.
$conditions.assured_continuity: AGI is not recognized and average final Reputation is below 3.
